why: The figures go in pairs. Pair 1: a circle with a small triangle inside, then the triangle moves out and sits on top of the circle. Pair 2: a triangle with a small circle inside, so next the circle moves out and sits on top of the triangle. That is option 3. Option 1 has a square on top, which never appeared.
trick: Pairs: the small shape inside comes out and sits on top.
